cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(PeepoArchiveDependencies LANGUAGES C)
include(ExternalProject)

set(ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION Release CACHE STRING "MSBuild configuration")
set(stage "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/stage")
set(common_args
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${stage}
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib
    -DCMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0091=NEW
    -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
    -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF)

ExternalProject_Add(archive_zlib
    URL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz"
    URL_HASH SHA256=bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP FALSE
    CMAKE_ARGS ${common_args} -DZLIB_BUILD_TESTING=OFF -DZLIB_BUILD_SHARED=OFF
    BUILD_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION} --parallel
    INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION})
ExternalProject_Add(archive_lzma
    URL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/xz-5.8.4.tar.gz"
    URL_HASH SHA256=0014c7886930454fe8bd4228665b51af55eeae560ea135c9c4cd33f55b2591d9
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP FALSE
    CMAKE_ARGS ${common_args} -DXZ_NLS=OFF -DXZ_DOC=OFF
        -DXZ_TOOL_XZ=OFF -DXZ_TOOL_XZDEC=OFF -DXZ_TOOL_LZMADEC=OFF -DXZ_TOOL_LZMAINFO=OFF
    BUILD_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION} --parallel
    INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION})
ExternalProject_Add(archive_bzip2
    URL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/bzip2-1.0.8.tar.gz"
    URL_HASH SHA256=ab5a03176ee106d3f0fa90e381da478ddae405918153cca248e682cd0c4a2269
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP FALSE
    CMAKE_ARGS ${common_args} -DBZIP2_SOURCE_DIR=<SOURCE_DIR>
    CONFIGURE_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -S "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bzip2" -B <BINARY_DIR>
        -G "${CMAKE_GENERATOR}" -A "${CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM}"
        ${common_args} -DBZIP2_SOURCE_DIR=<SOURCE_DIR>
    BUILD_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION} --parallel
    INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION})
ExternalProject_Add(archive_library
    DEPENDS archive_zlib archive_lzma archive_bzip2
    URL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libarchive-3.8.9.tar.xz"
    URL_HASH SHA256=888c934f9d95648ecb9163dc8e23ab80a476ecb81a8f1154704a227b5b676dde
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP FALSE
    PATCH_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DSOURCE_DIR=<SOURCE_DIR> -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ApplyRarCRC.cmake
    CMAKE_ARGS ${common_args} -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${stage} -DMSVC_USE_STATIC_CRT=ON
        -DZLIB_LIBRARY=${stage}/lib/zs$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:d>.lib
        -DENABLE_TEST=OFF -DENABLE_WERROR=OFF
        -DENABLE_TAR=OFF -DENABLE_CPIO=OFF -DENABLE_CAT=OFF -DENABLE_UNZIP=OFF
        -DENABLE_OPENSSL=OFF -DENABLE_MBEDTLS=OFF -DENABLE_NETTLE=OFF
        -DENABLE_LIBB2=OFF -DENABLE_LZ4=OFF -DENABLE_LZO=OFF -DENABLE_ZSTD=OFF
        -DENABLE_LIBXML2=OFF -DENABLE_EXPAT=OFF -DENABLE_WIN32_XMLLITE=OFF
        -DENABLE_PCREPOSIX=OFF -DENABLE_PCRE2POSIX=OFF
    BUILD_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION} --parallel
    INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install <BINARY_DIR> --config ${ARCHIVE_CONFIGURATION})

add_custom_target(archive_notices ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        -DSOURCE_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/archive_library-prefix/src/archive_library/libarchive
        -DOUTPUT_FILE=${stage}/libarchive-notices.txt
        -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/GenerateNotices.cmake
    DEPENDS archive_library)
